newsitem.title: USA: BTG Inc wins TVA Open Systems contract.
newsitem.headline: BTG Inc wins TVA Open Systems contract.

text.p: BTG Inc said on Wednesday it was awarded a $10 million, one-year contract by the Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA).
The contract has the option of four additional years, with potential contract capacity of $50 million. The work will be performed by BTG's operation in Chattanooga, Tennessee.

Under the terms of the award, BTG will provide TVA facilities throughout the Tennessee Valley with Unix-based servers, workstations, hardware, software and support services, including warranty maintenance and integration.
BTG provides information technology services and products to government and commercial clients.
